config.label: experiment-v2.1
config.status: APPROVED - amendment confirmed by the researcher on 2026-11-27. Supersedes configs/experiment-v2.json.

amendment.reason: Address the review findings: runs must actually execute in Docker, algorithm order must be rotated to avoid timing confound, git provenance must be recorded, and inference must use ML for the interaction test plus per-condition paired analysis. The v2.1 mixed-trace indexing change is a no-op for the approved parameters.
changes: execution.mode = docker; Docker memory limit and CPU allocation are now applied to every run
Algorithm order rotated by (workload_index + repetition + frame_index) mod 3 and recorded per run
Generator v2.1 uses per-segment local indexing for mixed sequential/looping, a no-op for the approved parameters; mixed traces are byte-identical to v2
Git commit and tag recorded in every raw record
Inference: ML likelihood-ratio test, per-condition paired tests, one Holm family, effective-n boundary rule
unchanged: Algorithms, workloads, frame capacities, trace length, repetitions, seed rule, outcome definitions, image and resource limits

measurement.timing: CLOCK_MONOTONIC around the policy loop only; trace reading excluded
